C145.name: Musoma Municipal Council
C145.documented: Lake Victoria floods and large waves, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.en: Musoma Municipal: Lake Victoria shore and low streets
area.sw: Manispaa ya Musoma: ufukwe wa Ziwa Victoria na mitaa ya chini

risk.en: This area is a lakeshore town where heavy storms flood low streets and landing sites, lake storms capsize boats and lightning strikes are frequent.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa ufukweni ambapo dhoruba kubwa hufurika mitaa ya chini na mialo, dhoruba za ziwani hupindua vyombo na radi hupiga mara kwa mara.

advice.en: For those living, fishing and trading here, it helps to keep drains open, build above known flood marks, wear life jackets on the lake and fit lightning arresters on public buildings. What raises the risk: building on the low lakeshore flats and landing sites, filling drains with waste, going out in overloaded or unlit boats and sheltering under trees when thunder starts. Know the higher street away from the shore that you will move to when the low streets flood, return to a sheltered landing as soon as clouds build over the lake, and get into a solid building when thunder is heard. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kuvua na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro wazi, kujenga juu ya alama za mafuriko zinazojulikana, kuvaa maboya ziwani na kuweka vizuia radi kwenye majengo ya umma. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye tambarare za chini za ufukweni na mialo, kujaza mitaro taka, kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na taa na kujikinga chini ya miti ngurumo zinapoanza. Fahamu mtaa wa juu mbali na ufukwe utakaohamia mitaa ya chini inapofurika, rudi kwenye mwalo uliokingwa mara mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, na ingia kwenye jengo imara ngurumo zinaposikika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C147.name: Bunda Town Council
C147.documented: lake floods, large waves, boat accidents, and heavy rain

area.en: Bunda Town: town streams and the highway corridor
area.sw: Mji wa Bunda: vijito vya mjini na ukanda wa barabara kuu

risk.en: This area is a growing town on the Mwanza–Musoma highway where storm run-off floods streets and roadside settlements, and traffic brings accident risk.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji unaokua kando ya barabara kuu ya Mwanza–Musoma ambapo maji ya dhoruba hufurika mitaa na makazi ya kando ya barabara, na magari huleta hatari ya ajali.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains and road culverts clear, trade outside the road reserve and keep goods above flood level. What raises the risk: setting up stalls and houses inside the road reserve, blocking the culverts with waste or structures, and crossing the highway with goods where vehicles cannot see. Know the higher ground away from the stream and the highway that you will move to when storm water rises, and leave the roadside before it is flooded; keep children off the road edge in rain and at night. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro na makalavati ya barabara wazi, kufanya biashara nje ya hifadhi ya barabara na kuhifadhi bidhaa juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuweka vibanda na nyumba ndani ya hifadhi ya barabara, kuziba makalavati kwa taka au majengo, na kuvuka barabara kuu na mizigo mahali magari hayawezi kuona. Fahamu eneo la juu mbali na kijito na barabara kuu utakalohamia maji ya dhoruba yanapopanda, na ondoka kando ya barabara kabla haijafurika; waweke watoto mbali na ukingo wa barabara wakati wa mvua na usiku. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C142.name: Tarime Town Council
C142.documented: heavy rain, mine accidents, and floods on valleys above the lake

area.en: Tarime Town: hillside town and border trade
area.sw: Mji wa Tarime: mji wa milimani na biashara ya mpakani

risk.en: This area is a hilly, high-rainfall town near the Kenya border where heavy storms cause flash floods and erosion, and busy cross-border trade can spread disease.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milimani wenye mvua nyingi karibu na mpaka wa Kenya ambapo dhoruba kubwa husababisha mafuriko ya ghafla na mmomonyoko, na biashara ya mpakani inaweza kusambaza magonjwa.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from gullies and use safe water, latrines and hand-washing. What raises the risk: cutting plots into the hillside gullies, tipping waste into the drains, and drinking untreated water or hiding cases of diarrhoea when trade is busy. Know the firm ground above the gullies that your household will move to in a heavy storm, and go when the stream rises towards the road; report unusual illness crossing the border the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na makorongo na kutumia maji salama, vyoo na kunawa mikono. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchonga viwanja kwenye makorongo ya milimani, kutupa taka kwenye mitaro, na kunywa maji yasiyotibiwa au kuficha wagonjwa wa kuharisha biashara ikiwa nyingi. Fahamu eneo imara juu ya makorongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia wakati wa dhoruba kali, na ondoka kijito kinapopanda kuelekea barabarani; ripoti ugonjwa usio wa kawaida unaovuka mpaka siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C146.name: Bunda District Council
C146.documented: Lake Victoria floods, large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and cholera

area.en: Bunda DC: Serengeti edge and lakeshore
area.sw: Bunda DC: pembezoni mwa Serengeti na ufukwe

risk.en: This area borders the Serengeti and Lake Victoria, where elephants raid crops, lake storms affect fishers and dry spells damage cotton and food crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na Serengeti na Ziwa Victoria, ambapo tembo huvamia mazao, dhoruba za ziwani huathiri wavuvi na vipindi vya ukavu huharibu pamba na mazao ya chakula.

advice.en: For those living, farming and fishing here, it helps to use community deterrents against wildlife, wear life jackets and plant drought-tolerant crops. What raises the risk: opening fields and settling right against the park boundary, going out in overloaded boats when the sky is building, and relying on one crop. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds over the lake, and the safe village gathering place if elephants or buffalo come into the fields at night; in a dry year, agree early where food will come from. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama, kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa na kupanda mazao yanayostahimili ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari: kufungua mashamba na kukaa moja kwa moja mpakani mwa hifadhi, kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa anga linapojengeka, na kutegemea zao moja. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka ziwani, na mahali salama pa kukusanyika kijijini tembo au nyati wakiingia mashambani usiku; mwaka wa ukame, kubalianeni mapema chakula kitatoka wapi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C148.name: Butiama District Council
C148.documented: lake-edge floods, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.sw: Butiama: mashamba na mito ya msimu

risk.en: This area has farmland crossed by seasonal rivers that flood crossings after storms, and erratic rains that cause crop losses.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba yanayokatizwa na mito ya msimu inayofurika vivuko baada ya dhoruba, na mvua zisizo za uhakika zinazosababisha hasara ya mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to know the low crossings on your route, keep stores above flood level and keep household food reserves. What raises the risk: trying to cross a flooded drift on foot, by motorcycle or with cattle, building in the river bends, and relying on one crop. Know the dry route and the raised ground your household will use when the rivers rise, and wait on the safe side of a crossing until the water drops; in a dry year, agree early where food will come from. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kujua vivuko vya chini kwenye njia zenu, kuhifadhi mali juu ya kiwango cha mafuriko na kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujaribu kuvuka kivuko kilichofurika kwa miguu, pikipiki au na ng'ombe, kujenga kwenye mikunjo ya mto, na kutegemea zao moja. Fahamu njia kavu na eneo lililoinuka ambalo kaya yako itatumia mito inapojaa, na subiri upande salama wa kivuko hadi maji yapungue; mwaka wa ukame, kubalianeni mapema chakula kitatoka wapi. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C144.name: Musoma District Council
C144.documented: lake floods, large waves, boat accidents, and heavy rain

area.en: Musoma DC: lakeshore villages and the Mara wetlands
area.sw: Musoma DC: vijiji vya ufukweni na ardhioevu ya Mara

risk.en: This area has lakeshore fishing villages and the Mara river wetlands, which flood farms and villages in wet years, and cholera spreads where water is unsafe.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya wavuvi vya ufukweni na ardhioevu ya mto Mara inayofurika mashamba na vijiji katika miaka ya mvua nyingi, na kipindupindu husambaa pasipo maji salama.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to keep homes above the wetland margin, use latrines and boil or treat drinking water. What raises the risk: settling on the wetland margin because the soil is rich, drawing drinking water from the lake edge after a flood, and hiding cases of diarrhoea. Know the higher ground your village will move to when the Mara wetlands spread, move stores and animals there early, and report the first case of watery diarrhoea the same day. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kujenga juu ya kingo za ardhioevu, kutumia vyoo na kuchemsha au kutibu maji ya kunywa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukaa kwenye kingo za ardhioevu kwa sababu udongo una rutuba, kuchota maji ya kunywa ukingoni mwa ziwa baada ya mafuriko, na kuficha wagonjwa wa kuharisha. Fahamu eneo la juu ambalo kijiji chenu kitahamia ardhioevu ya Mara inapotanuka, hamisheni akiba na mifugo huko mapema, na ripoti mgonjwa wa kwanza wa kuharisha maji siku hiyo hiyo. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C149.name: Rorya District Council
C149.documented: lake floods, large waves, boat accidents, and human–wildlife conflict on the Mara River

area.en: Rorya: lakeshore, islands and Kenya border
area.sw: Rorya: ufukwe, visiwa na mpaka wa Kenya

risk.en: This area has a long lakeshore and islands where storms capsize boats and lightning strikes fishers, and border villages where disease can spread with movement.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina ufukwe mrefu na visiwa ambapo dhoruba hupindua vyombo na radi huwapiga wavuvi, na vijiji vya mpakani ambapo magonjwa yanaweza kusambaa kwa mwingiliano.

advice.en: For those fishing and living here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore before storms build and report unusual illness early. What raises the risk: going out in overloaded or unlit boats, fishing on when clouds build over the lake, sheltering under trees when thunder starts, and hiding illness that arrives with border movement. Know the sheltered landing you will run to when a storm builds and the solid building you will shelter in from lightning; on the islands, agree early who will carry a sick person to the mainland and by which boat. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaovua na kuishi hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni kabla dhoruba haijaanza na kutoa taarifa mapema za magonjwa yasiyo ya kawaida. Kinachoongeza hatari: kutoka ziwani kwa vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na taa, kuendelea kuvua mawingu yanapojengeka juu ya ziwa, kujikinga chini ya miti ngurumo zinapoanza, na kuficha ugonjwa unaokuja na mwingiliano wa mpakani. Fahamu mwalo uliokingwa utakaokimbilia dhoruba inapojengeka na jengo imara mtakalojikinga na radi; visiwani, kubalianeni mapema nani atambeba mgonjwa hadi bara na kwa chombo gani. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C143.name: Serengeti District Council
C143.documented: drought, wildfire, flash floods on the Mara, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Serengeti: villages next to the national park
area.sw: Serengeti: vijiji jirani na hifadhi ya taifa

risk.en: This area borders Serengeti National Park, where wildlife raids crops and attacks people, dry-season fires spread from grassland and drought affects herds.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na Hifadhi ya Taifa Serengeti, ambapo wanyamapori huvamia mazao na kushambulia watu, moto wa kiangazi husambaa kutoka nyasi na ukame huathiri mifugo.

advice.en: For those living, farming and herding here, it helps to use community deterrents, keep fire breaks and plan grazing and water for dry years. What raises the risk: settling and farming right against the park boundary, walking alone at night where wildlife moves, burning grass on windy days, and keeping more animals than the dry-season pasture can carry. Know the cleared open ground your village will move to if fire comes and the safe gathering place if dangerous animals enter the village; in a drought year, agree early where the herds will go and move before they weaken. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kufuga hapa, ni vyema kutumia mbinu za jamii, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kupanga malisho na maji kwa miaka ya ukame. Kinachoongeza hatari: kukaa na kulima moja kwa moja mpakani mwa hifadhi, kutembea peke yako usiku mahali wanyama hupita, kuchoma nyasi siku za upepo, na kuweka mifugo mingi kuliko malisho ya kiangazi yanavyoweza kubeba. Fahamu uwanja wazi uliosafishwa ambao kijiji chenu kitahamia moto ukija na mahali salama pa kukusanyika wanyama hatari wakiingia kijijini; mwaka wa ukame, kubalianeni mapema mifugo itaenda wapi na hamieni kabla haijadhoofika. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C141.name: Tarime District Council
C141.documented: heavy rain, artisanal and large-scale mining accidents, and valley floods

area.en: Tarime DC: high-rainfall hills and mining areas
area.sw: Tarime DC: milima yenye mvua nyingi na maeneo ya uchimbaji

risk.en: This area has high-rainfall hills where storms cause landslides, flash floods and lightning, and gold-mining areas (such as Nyamongo) where pits collapse and water is polluted.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina milima yenye mvua nyingi ambapo dhoruba husababisha maporomoko, mafuriko ya ghafla na radi, na maeneo ya uchimbaji wa dhahabu (kama Nyamongo) ambapo mashimo hubomoka na maji huchafuliwa.

advice.en: For those living, farming and mining here, it helps to keep slopes planted, fence or backfill pits and keep processing away from drinking-water sources. What raises the risk: digging pits without timbering, working them while rain is falling, washing ore in the streams people drink from, sheltering under trees when thunder starts, and cutting plots into the wet slopes. Keep everyone out of the pits once rain starts and know the firm ground away from the pits and gullies that your household will move to; agree with neighbours on a safe place off the slope and go there when cracks open. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo na kuchenjua mbali na vyanzo vya maji ya kunywa. Kinachoongeza hatari: kuchimba mashimo bila mihimili, kuyafanyia kazi mvua ikinyesha, kuosha mawe ya madini kwenye vijito ambavyo watu hunywa, kujikinga chini ya miti ngurumo zinapoanza, na kuchonga viwanja kwenye miteremko yenye unyevu. Mtoe kila mtu mashimoni mara mvua inapoanza na fahamu eneo imara mbali na mashimo na makorongo ambalo kaya yako itahamia; kubalianeni na majirani eneo salama nje ya mteremko na nendeni huko nyufa zikifunguka. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
